capabilities.summary: Shared review capability: typed deterministic checks over a media or brief description, declared holds, a hard-capped repair loop, an advisory judge interface that cannot override deterministic failures, and versioned verdict records.
policyNotes: Package contract retained; dependency declarations do not verify integration.
No precise implementation fingerprint; declaration-only inventory, never enforced ownership or verified integration.
Consumers (GenRight G6, CutRight C10, PostRight P4) own their review policy and copy; this crate owns the checks and verdict semantics.
